Holdout: 20 configs (cash 2/3/6/9/10 players x Mixed/Tough/Soft, sit-and-go 7-max, top cash stake, edited Custom) x 25 hands with random user play through fake-indexeddb: every stored session equals nextHand(done) field by field, restoreSession deep-equals nextHand, getSession == written, hand records read back equal. Browser holdout (Chromium+WebKit): after hands 1 and 2 the stored stacks/names/styles equal the UI at Hand over and the stored button equals the dealer shown in the next hand.

e2e/session-records.spec.ts passes in Chromium and WebKit; it asserts start record handsPlayed 0 and config, handsPlayed 2 with the same sessionId as 2 hand records, deep-equal after reload mid hand 3, no hand 3 record, same-origin requests (mutants 'no start write' and 'no session in add' killed). findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected: the REQ-025 guarantee that a stored session cannot move the user's view to a bot seat is held by an automated test. Actual: behaviour is correct (a record whose seats mark a bot seat as the user while config is unchanged is rejected with RangeError), but deleting the record-seat-kind vs config-seat-kind check leaves every builder test green.
findings.fix: Add an acceptance case where the record's seats swap the user and a bot (bot ids kept unique and below nextBotId, config untouched) and assert restoreSession throws RangeError naming the seat kind.

findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected: a restored session yields a table whose hand number is a safe integer. Actual: handsPlayed = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER is accepted and restoreSession returns handNumber 2^53; the next hand's write then fails closed with 'Invalid hand record: handNumber'.
findings.fix: Bound handsPlayed so handsPlayed + 1 is a safe integer (reject with 'Invalid session record: handsPlayed').

findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected (D-7): assertChips extraction leaves createHand's behaviour unchanged. Actual: when both the stakes and the deck are invalid, createHand now reports the deck error instead of 'Invalid stakes' (the stake check moved after the deck check). Messages themselves are unchanged and all existing engine suites pass.
findings.fix: Optional: keep the original precedence or record the order change in the docs.

summary: All 17 SPEC items PASS on observed behaviour. npm test 942 passed / 0 failed; full e2e 184 passed; CI green; both playtest hashes match. The dev-server run, every-push reload spec, opt-in kill spec and an independent kill at hand 5 behave as specified. Hostile fuzzing (about 2,350 session-record, config, createHand and hand-record mutations) produced only RangeErrors and no TypeError. 600 real hand records parse with no false rejects. The v1 to v2 upgrade keeps seeded hands. Mutation testing killed 19 of 20 mutants. The one survivor is a test gap: the record-vs-config seat-kind check has no test (J-1-01, MEDIUM). Two LOW notes. No blocking findings. The story-doc part of SPEC-17 is pending the documentor.
